description: This Java class `ProductReviewController` is a Spring MVC controller handling product review related administrative functionalities in a web application. It includes methods for displaying product reviews, paginating review data, and removing reviews, with security annotations to restrict access to authorized roles. The file interacts with services for products and reviews, builds responses for AJAX calls, and manages view models for web pages.

classes.name: ProductReviewController
classes.description: Controller class managing product review operations including viewing, pagination, and deletion in an admin context.

methods.name: displayProductReviews
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the product review page for a specific product, verifying ownership and product existence.

methods.name: pageProductReviews
methods.description: Processes POST AJAX requests to retrieve a paginated list of reviews for a product, returning JSON data.

methods.name: deleteProductReview
methods.description: Processes AJAX POST requests to delete a specific review, ensuring authorization.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Sets up menu context for the views, marking active menu items.
